scope: optional personal Open Food Facts account in the direct browser lane

officialOffSemantics.browserConstraint: OFF returns wildcard CORS without credential support and a SameSite=Lax session cookie, so a cross-site Pages PWA cannot portably reuse that cookie

directRequestUse.publicDocumentationDeviation: OFF publicly recommends credential parameters only for POST, PUT and DELETE; direct authenticated GET is a deliberate user-approved compatibility compromise because its credentialed cross-site cookie is not browser-portable
